Local-mode internals (spawned by `lobo up --provider local`)

Usage:
  lobo local [command]

Available Commands:
  run         Supervise llama-server on this Mac and serve the agent API on 127.0.0.1:--api-port

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for local

Global Flags:
      --config string   config file (dotenv; the OS env is never read) (default "/home/u/.config/lobo/config.env")

Use "lobo local [command] --help" for more information about a command.
